style_reference: ICLR 2027 author instructions and the conference style file (US Letter, 5.5in text width).
notes: Main text is 9 pages at submission. Pages from the first References heading onward, including appendices, do not count. The margin floor is 0.5in. This profile is not a fitted review score.
